_approach: Floating breakdown: offbeat open hats are the only constant, skippy closed hats on the 'a' pickups imply the shuffle, a single soft kick on the downbeat of bar 1 tethers it to the floor, and a clap appears once per bar. Designed to sit under a vocal or a filtered bassline before the build. Ref: Tina Moore 'Never Gonna Let You Go' (Kelly G mix) breakdown, Gant 'Sound Bwoy Burial'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
